msgs.text: Genera 5 imágenes separadas con Nano Banana 2.1, cada una en su formato y con su referencia (las referencias están adjuntas). Usa los textos tal cual, sin reescribirlos ni añadir nada. REGLA A: Use the EXACT garment(s) and accessories from the reference image: identical cut, length, fabric, colour, print, buttons, trims and details. Do not redesign, recolour or add garments. Show the clothes on a professional female fashion model (a woman). If the reference is a mirror selfie, the new photo has no phone, no mirror and no selfie pose. Photorealistic, high-end commercial photography, natural skin texture, crisp material detail, no text, no letters, no watermark, no logos, no brand names, no frames, no collage, no words or labels anywhere in the image. IMAGEN 1 «h» (formato 16:9, referencia chabeli-modas-20.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): A stylish Spanish woman in her thirties wearing an olive green wrap blazer with a tie belt and matching olive wide trousers from the reference, walking at a sunny street in the old town of Jerez de la Frontera, Cádiz, Spain, with whitewashed walls, golden hour. One single continuous photograph, never a split screen, diptych, panel or collage. The subject stands in the right third of the frame and the same scene continues to the left, softly out of focus and calm, with room for a headline. Wide editorial campaign image, cinematic natural light. IMAGEN 2 «p1» (formato 3:4, referencia chabeli-modas-18.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo for a fashion boutique: a model wearing a multicolour floral print blouse with black velvet bow ties down the front with white trousers from the reference, standing naturally, framed from just above the lips (face cropped at the mouth) down to the shoes so the whole outfit is visible, centred, on a seamless warm light (#ECE7E0) studio background with a soft natural floor shadow, soft diffused daylight from the left. IMAGEN 3 «p2» (formato 3:4, referencia chabeli-modas-19.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo for a fashion boutique: a model wearing a multicolour striped satin shirt knotted at the waist with light blue jeans from the reference, standing naturally, framed from just above the lips (face cropped at the mouth) down to the shoes so the whole outfit is visible, centred, on a seamless warm light (#ECE7E0) studio background with a soft natural floor shadow, soft diffused daylight from the left. IMAGEN 4 «p3» (formato 3:4, referencia chabeli-modas-22.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo for a fashion boutique: a model wearing a pink, teal and black abstract print blouse with ruffled shoulders and white trousers from the reference, standing naturally, framed from just above the lips (face cropped at the mouth) down to the shoes so the whole outfit is visible, centred, on a seamless warm light (#ECE7E0) studio background with a soft natural floor shadow, soft diffused daylight from the left. IMAGEN 5 «p4» (formato 3:4, referencia chabeli-modas-06.jpg, aplica la REGLA A): E-commerce product photo for a fashion boutique: a model wearing a brown and cream paisley quilted jacket over a white turtleneck with cream trousers from the reference, standing naturally, framed from just above the lips (face cropped at the mouth) down to the shoes so the whole outfit is visible, centred, on a seamless warm light (#ECE7E0) studio background with a soft natural floor shadow, soft diffused daylight from the left.
